description: Search the raw per-provider GPU rental price table (USD per GPU-hour), sorted cheapest first. Use this when you need more than the single cheapest offer: comparing providers for one GPU, finding spot, preemptible or reserved rates, or checking one provider's prices. For just the lowest on-demand price of one GPU, call cheapest_gpu; for an overview of all GPUs, call list_gpus. Returns up to `limit` rows, each with provider, gpu, variant, price, price_type, term, region, source_url and date_checked. Rows without a public numeric price (contact sales) are excluded.

gpu.description: Exact GPU model to match, case and punctuation insensitive, e.g. H100, H200, A100, L40S, B200, MI300X. Omit for all GPUs.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return after sorting cheapest first (1 to 50, default 10).

price_type.description: Pricing model to keep: on_demand (pay as you go), spot or preemptible (interruptible discount), reserved (committed term), serverless_per_second. Omit for all types.

provider.description: Provider name or part of it, case insensitive, e.g. "runpod", "lambda", "vast", "aws". Omit for all providers.

name: get_prices
title: Search GPU rental price rows
